experiment: CSS 4-frame real-vs-bogus, 693 labeled subjects (241 real/452 bogus within retrieved set), stratified 75/25 split, test n=174
note: ALL subjects already passed CSS survey screening with high digest2 — this is the hard residual where the current system needs human eyes
finding: image-derived signal (motion features AUC 0.73, raw pixels 0.71) is orthogonal to digest2 (AUC 0.46 = uninformative on this subset); a trained image model recovers discrimination where the tabular pipeline is blind
caveats: GBM on downsampled pixels is a weak stand-in for a CNN
693 subjects is ~3% of the available dataset — scale up before strong claims
hand-tuned motion heuristic was WORSE than random (0.41): features good, hand-weights bad
